title: How a buy happens
one_liner: The sequence an agency follows from planning a purchase to explaining the award, and what a firm can read at each step.

title: Other transactions 101
one_liner: An other transaction is a binding agreement that is not a procurement contract, grant or cooperative agreement, used mostly for defense research and prototypes.

title: Partnering forms 101
one_liner: Six ways to work with another firm on federal work, each with its own answer on size, work share and payment.

title: Reading a SAM.gov notice
one_liner: A SAM.gov notice is a short record: a type code, a set-aside code, an industry code, an active flag and a response deadline.

title: SBIR phases 101
one_liner: SBIR and STTR fund a small firm's own research in phases; only the first two draw on the reserved money.

title: Size and affiliation 101
one_liner: Small is a measured status: a ceiling per industry code, with the firms a business is tied to counted in.

title: What a set-aside is
one_liner: A purchase the contracting officer restricts to small businesses, or to one certified program, because enough of them are expected to compete.

title: Where the numbers live
one_liner: A threshold lives in a statute, a regulation, a directive or deviation, and an agency page, and those layers do not update together.
